reason: C3 is a small decoupling/charge-storage capacitor on the IB2→net5 path; removing it typically preserves the switching and bias transfer function and mainly affects transient smoothing/noise filtering. Caveat: without it, IB2-related ripple/kickback at net5 can increase when VCONT4 toggles.
impact_estimate: Low for DC / logical functionality; Medium for noise/transient integrity.

reason: C2 is a similar decoupling/hold capacitor on the IB1→net17 path; the transmission-gate routing and NMOS network can still function without it, just with less bias-node filtering/hold. Caveat: may increase glitching on net17 and degrade dynamic bias stability if the design relies on charge storage.
impact_estimate: Low for steady-state behavior; Medium for dynamic bias stability.

reason: M10 is an NMOS controlled by VTRACK2 that primarily discharges/clamps net22; the cross-coupled pair M8/M9 and associated bias devices can still operate if net22 is otherwise well-defined by leakage/other paths. Caveat: removing it may slow reset of net22 and increase sensitivity to charge accumulation, affecting repeatability across cycles.
impact_estimate: Low to Medium (reset/robustness may degrade, core function usually remains).
